page_title: RAY 0-1 SEV | Rayo Vallecano v Sevilla 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is told to leave the pitch after receiving a red card from the referee for dissent! The manager looks really angry about his irresponsible behaviour.
90+5' Peque (Sevilla) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.

90+5' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Odysseas Vlachodimos inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
90+3' Matias Almeyda has decided to make a change. Peque (Sevilla) replaces Alexis Sanchez.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuel Becerra (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Oscar Valentin.
90+2' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Jesus Manzano sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
89' Wait! Referee Jesus Manzano has indicated he is going to review the Sevilla goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
87' 0 - 1 Jose Angel Carmona plays a neat ball into the path of Akor Adams (Sevilla), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the crossbar! 0:1.
85' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
82' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
78' Substitution. Alemao makes his way off the pitch and Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as his replacement.
78' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Isi Palazon is replaced by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabio Cardoso (Sevilla) trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ramon Martinez.
77' Substitution. Lucien Agoume is replaced by Djibril Sow (Sevilla).
77' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
76' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Sevilla force their opponents to concede a corner.
74' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.

70' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
69' Substitution. Akor Adams (Sevilla) replaces Isaac Romero.
69' Substitution. Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) has come on for Ruben Vargas.
67' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Jorge de Frutos will be replaced by Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) for Pedro Diaz.
67' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for a foul. Jesus Manzano had a clear view and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Sevilla.

66' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
66' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Rayo Vallecano.

65' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
64' Sevilla are ruled offside.
61' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
60' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Good work from Sevilla as they win a corner.
59' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) is penalised for holding. Jesus Manzano signals a set piece. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
58' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
58' Rayo Vallecano are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
54' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
53' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
52' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
52' The resulting corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) comes to nothing. The referee blows his whistle, Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.
51' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano). Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

51' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.

49' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Odysseas Vlachodimos shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!

49' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
49' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.
48' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

48' It's unbelievable, Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards the roof of the net, but Odysseas Vlachodimos reacts superbly to keep the ball out. Corner kick. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity.
48' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Jesus Manzano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
48' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Rayo Vallecano are awarded the free kick.
47' Fabio Cardoso (Sevilla) commits a rough foul. Jesus Manzano stops the game and makes a call. Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+1' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Rayo Vallecano win a corner.
44' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
42' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a free kick.

39' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Odysseas Vlachodimos shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
39' Rayo Vallecano are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
36' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
36' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Sevilla get a corner.
34' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
33' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Sevilla are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
26' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
25' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) was too forceful with his tackle and Jesus Manzano interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
22' Rayo Vallecano fail to score from a corner as Odysseas Vlachodimos (Sevilla) leaps to collect the ball.
20' Rough tackle by Fabio Cardoso (Sevilla). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Rayo Vallecano.
18' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jesus Manzano blows for a foul. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
16' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Sevilla have a free kick.

14' Jesus Manzano blows for a foul after Fabio Cardoso (Sevilla) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Rayo Vallecano win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
11' Great teamplay by Rayo Vallecano as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
8' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
3' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

2' What a great touch by Isaac Romero (Sevilla) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Sevilla will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jesus Manzano.
